follow100Note: Per $100 of gross revenue (before client incentives). Measured against Visa's reported net revenue of $9.6B instead, the kept profit is $47.71 per $100. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Visa reports 'net revenue' of $9,594M; this page starts from gross revenue of $13,328M so the $3,734M of client incentives shows as a cost.
oneTimers: A litigation provision of $1,000M sits in operating expenses — $992M of it is the special item for the interchange multidistrict litigation (MDL) case; Visa excludes it from non-GAAP results.

Also excluded from non-GAAP results: $96M of amortization of acquired intangible assets and acquisition-related costs, and $23M of net losses on equity investments. Non-GAAP net income was $5.4B ($2.76 per share).
otherDetail: Investment income and other gains of $161M, less $158M of interest expense — net +$3M.

segments.name: Service revenue
segments.note: Fees from banks for using the Visa brand and network on cards — based on the prior quarter's payments volume.

segments.name: Data processing revenue
segments.note: Fees for clearing and processing each transaction — processed transactions grew 9%.

segments.name: International transaction revenue
segments.note: Fees when a card is used outside its home country — cross-border volume rose 13% in constant dollars.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Value-added services — fraud tools, data and consulting for banks and merchants.

takeaways.text: Net revenue rose 9% to $9.6B — data processing +10%, international transactions +10%, service revenue +9% and other revenue +24%. Payments volume grew 8% and cross-border volume 13% in constant dollars; processed transactions rose 9%.
takeaways.title: Volume growth stayed solid

takeaways.text: Non-GAAP EPS was $2.76, up 10%, and non-GAAP net income $5.4B, up 6%. GAAP EPS rose just 1% to $2.32 because of the legal charge below.
takeaways.title: Underlying EPS rose 10%

takeaways.text: The litigation provision was $1,000M — mostly the special item for the interchange MDL case — versus $430M a year ago. GAAP operating expenses rose 22%; excluding such items, they rose 7%.
takeaways.title: The legal bill spiked again

verdict: Visa's net revenue rose 9% to $9.6B as payments volume grew 8% and cross-border volume 13% — but a $1,000M litigation provision left GAAP profit slightly lower at $4.6B, even as underlying EPS rose 10%.
